name: Coolify
description: Interact with your Coolify instance to manage applications, servers, databases, services, deployments, and projects.

tools.name: coolify_list_applications
tools.label: List Coolify applications
tools.description: List all applications on your Coolify instance, optionally filtered by tag.

tools.name: coolify_get_application
tools.label: Get Coolify application
tools.description: Get details of a specific Coolify application by its UUID.
tools.promptSnippet: Get details of a Coolify application.

tools.name: coolify_application_action
tools.label: Start/Stop/Restart Coolify application
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify application by UUID.
tools.promptSnippet: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify application.

tools.name: coolify_delete_application
tools.label: Delete Coolify application
tools.description: Delete a Coolify application by UUID. Optionally remove associated resources.

tools.name: coolify_list_servers
tools.label: List Coolify servers
tools.description: List all servers configured in your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_server
tools.label: Get Coolify server
tools.description: Get details of a specific Coolify server by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_get_server_resources
tools.label: Get Coolify server resources
tools.description: List all resources (applications, databases, services) deployed on a specific server.
tools.promptSnippet: List resources on a Coolify server.

tools.name: coolify_get_server_domains
tools.label: Get Coolify server domains
tools.description: List all domains configured on a specific server.
tools.promptSnippet: List domains on a Coolify server.

tools.name: coolify_validate_server
tools.label: Validate Coolify server
tools.description: Validate a Coolify server connection by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_list_databases
tools.label: List Coolify databases
tools.description: List all databases on your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_database
tools.label: Get Coolify database
tools.description: Get details of a specific Coolify database by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_database_action
tools.label: Start/Stop/Restart Coolify database
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify database by UUID.
tools.promptSnippet: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify database.

tools.name: coolify_list_services
tools.label: List Coolify services
tools.description: List all services on your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_service
tools.label: Get Coolify service
tools.description: Get details of a specific Coolify service by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_service_action
tools.label: Start/Stop/Restart Coolify service
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify service by UUID.
tools.promptSnippet: Start, stop, or restart a Coolify service.

tools.name: coolify_list_deployments
tools.label: List Coolify deployments
tools.description: List deployments, optionally filtered by application UUID.

tools.name: coolify_get_deployment
tools.label: Get Coolify deployment
tools.description: Get details of a specific deployment by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_deploy
tools.label: Deploy on Coolify
tools.description: Trigger a deployment by application UUID or tag. Optionally force rebuild.
promptGuidelines: Use this tool to deploy or redeploy an application.
Provide either uuid or tag to identify what to deploy.

tag.description: Tag name to deploy all tagged resources.

tools.name: coolify_list_projects
tools.label: List Coolify projects
tools.description: List all projects on your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_project
tools.label: Get Coolify project
tools.description: Get details of a specific Coolify project by UUID.

tools.name: coolify_list_resources
tools.label: List Coolify resources
tools.description: List all resources (applications, databases, services) across the Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_list_teams
tools.label: List Coolify teams
tools.description: List all teams on your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_current_team
tools.label: Get current Coolify team
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated team and its members.

tools.name: coolify_healthcheck
tools.label: Coolify health check
tools.description: Check if your Coolify instance is healthy and reachable.

tools.name: coolify_version
tools.label: Coolify version
tools.description: Get the version of your Coolify instance.

tools.name: coolify_get_application_logs
tools.label: Get Coolify application logs
tools.description: Get logs of a Coolify application by UUID.

lines.description: Number of log lines to return (default 100).
